42863-bright-ideas-for-entertaining.title: Day, New Year's Eve, and other holidays.
42863-bright-ideas-for-entertaining.creator: Mrs. Herbert B. Linscott
42863-bright-ideas-for-entertaining.description: A book by Mrs. Herbert B. Linscott. Cut out pictures from advertisements; for instance, from "Quaker Oats," cut out the Quaker, but nothing that will tell what it represents. Have a number of them and paste on plain white paper. Number each ad, and keep a "key" to them yourself. Furnish paper and pencil to each guest and have them guess what each picture represents. The one who guesses the most receives a prize. Also request every one to write an advertisement on some article.

arxiv-1903-02140.title: Why Learning of Large-Scale Neural Networks Behaves Like Convex Optimization
arxiv-1903-02140.creator: Hui Jiang
arxiv-1903-02140.description: Abstract In this paper, we present some theoretical work to explain why simple gradient descent methods are so successful in solving non-convex optimization problems in learning large-scale neural networks (NN). After introducing a mathematical tool called canonical space , we have proved that the objective functions in learning NNs are convex in the canonical model space.

arxiv-2209-01413.title: Effects of a phase transition on two-pion interferometry in heavy-ion collisions at s NN = 2.4 − 7.7 \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}}=2.4-7.7 GeV
arxiv-2209-01413.creator: Pengcheng Li 1,2,3 , Jan Steinheimer 4 , Tom Reichert 1,6 , Apiwit Kittiratpattana 1,7 , Marcus Bleicher 1,5,6 ,Qingfeng Li 2,3
arxiv-2209-01413.description: Abstract Hanbury-Brown-Twiss (HBT) correlations for charged pions in central Au+Au collisions at s NN = 2.4 − 7.7 \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}}=2.4-7.7 GeV (corresponding to beam kinetic energies in the fixed target frame from E lab = 1.23 E_{\rm{lab}}=1.23 to 30 GeV/nucleon) are calculated using the UrQMD model with different equations of state.

arxiv-2302-11054.title: Conversational Text-to-SQL: An Odyssey into State-of-the-Art and Challenges Ahead
arxiv-2302-11054.creator: Sree Hari Krishnan Parthasarathi, Lu Zeng, Dilek Hakkani-Tür
arxiv-2302-11054.description: Abstract Conversational, multi-turn, text-to-SQL (CoSQL) tasks map natural language utterances in a dialogue to SQL queries. State-of-the-art (SOTA) systems use large, pre-trained and finetuned language models, such as the T5-family, in conjunction with constrained decoding. With multi-tasking (MT) over coherent tasks with discrete prompts during training, we improve over specialized text-to-SQL T5-family models.

arxiv-2307-15781.title: Linear quadratic Chabauty
arxiv-2307-15781.creator: Stevan Gajović, J. Steffen Müller
arxiv-2307-15781.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Stevan Gajović, J. Steffen Müller. We introduce a new quadratic Chabauty method to compute the integral points on certain even degree hyperelliptic curves. Our approach relies on a nontrivial degree zero divisor supported at the two points at infinity to restrict the p p -adic height to a linear function; we can then express this restriction in terms of holomorphic Coleman integrals under the standard quadratic Chabauty assumption. Then we use this linear relation to extract the integral points on the curve.

arxiv-2312-11729.title: RenderCore – a new WebGPU-based rendering engine for ROOT-EVE
arxiv-2312-11729.creator: \firstname Ciril \lastname Bohak, \firstname Dmytro \lastname Kovalskyi, \firstname Sergey \lastname Linev, \firstname Alja \lastname Mrak Tadel, \firstname Sebastien \lastname Strban, \firstname Matevž \lastname Tadel \fnsep, \firstname Avi \lastname Yagil
arxiv-2312-11729.description: Abstract ROOT-Eve (REve), the new generation of the ROOT event-display module, uses a web server-client model to guarantee exact data translation from the experiments’ data analysis frameworks to users’ browsers. Data is then displayed in various views, including high-precision 2D and 3D graphics views, currently driven by THREE.js rendering engine based on WebGL technology.

arxiv-2404-17668.title: Precise Object Placement Using Force-Torque Feedback
arxiv-2404-17668.creator: Osher Lerner, Zachary Tam, Michael Equi
arxiv-2404-17668.description: Abstract Precise object manipulation and placement is a common problem for household robots, surgery robots, and robots working on in-situ construction. Prior work using computer vision, depth sensors, and reinforcement learning lacks the ability to reactively recover from planning errors, execution errors, or sensor noise.

arxiv-2502-01329.title: Benchmarking Different QP Formulations and Solvers for Dynamic Quadrupedal Walking
arxiv-2502-01329.creator: Franek Stark, Jakob Middelberg, Dennis Mronga, Shubham Vyas, Frank Kirchner
arxiv-2502-01329.description: Abstract Quadratic Programs (QPs) are widely used in the control of walking robots, especially in Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Whole-Body Control (WBC) . In both cases, the controller design requires the formulation of a QP and the selection of a suitable QP solver, both requiring considerable time and expertise.

arxiv-2505-06244.title: The fallacies of Λ \Lambda CDM falsifications
arxiv-2505-06244.creator: Alain Blanchard
arxiv-2505-06244.description: Abstract In recent years, numerous arguments have emerged suggesting that the Λ \Lambda CDM (Lambda Cold Dark Matter) model may be inconsistent with observational data, requiring more or less radical revisions. Notable examples include the ‘Hubble tension’—the discrepancy between early- and late-universe measurements of the Hubble constant—as well as tensions in measurements of cosmic structure growth.

arxiv-2509-01098.title: CCE: Confidence-Consistency Evaluation for Time Series Anomaly Detection
arxiv-2509-01098.creator: Zhijie Zhong, Zhiwen Yu 1, Yiu-ming Cheung, Kaixiang Yang
arxiv-2509-01098.description: Abstract Time Series Anomaly Detection metrics serve as crucial tools for model evaluation. However, existing metrics suffer from several limitations: insufficient discriminative power, strong hyperparameter dependency, sensitivity to perturbations, and high computational overhead. This paper introduces Confidence-Consistency Evaluation (CCE), a novel evaluation metric that simultaneously measures prediction confidence and uncertainty consistency.

arxiv-2602-07298.title: Principled Synthetic Data Enables the First Scaling Laws for LLMs in Recommendation
arxiv-2602-07298.creator: Benyu Zhang, Qiang Zhang, Jianpeng Cheng, Hong-You Chen, Qifei Wang, Wei Sun, Shen Li, Jia Li, Jiahao Wu, Xiangjun Fan, Hong Yan
arxiv-2602-07298.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) represent a promising frontier for recommender systems, yet their development has been impeded by the absence of predictable scaling laws, which are crucial for guiding research and optimizing resource allocation. We hypothesize that this may be attributed to the inherent noise, bias, and incompleteness of raw user interaction data in prior continual pre-training (CPT) efforts.

pmc-10741392.title: Biomimetic Random Pulse Computation or Why Do Humans Play Basketball Better than Robots?
pmc-10741392.creator: Mario Stipčević, Honghao Zhang, Yong Peng, Danqi Wang, Dongkai Chu
pmc-10741392.description: In this work, we compare the basketball scoring performance of two imaginary (simulated) mechanical robots in conditions of erroneous information-processing circuits: Machine, whose moves are controlled by a conventional digital computer and Man, controlled by a random pulse computer composed of biologically-inspired circuits which execute basic arithmetic operations.

pmc-11484562.title: Botryomycosis Secondary to Staphylococcus simulans Masquerading as Mycetoma in a 46-year-old Filipino Female
pmc-11484562.creator: Ysabel Regina H. Ortiz, Maria Christina Filomena R. Batac
pmc-11484562.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Botryomycosis is a rare pyogenic disease that presents with chronic suppurative and granulomatous skin lesions, commonly caused by Staphylococcus aureus. We report a case of botryomycosis presenting similarly to mycetoma, secondary to the emerging cutaneous pathogen Staphylococcus simulans. A 46‐year‐old female who previously worked in a wet market presented with a 13‐year history of suppurative papules on a gradually enlarging right foot, and pain on ambulation. She had no systemic symptoms or co‐morbidities, and does not recall preceding trauma.

pmc-11591523.title: The Influence of Verb-Based Implicit Causality Information and Second Language Proficiency on Chinese English Learners’ Pronoun Anaphoric Inference: Evidence from Eye Movements
pmc-11591523.creator: Huan Liu, Shifa Chen, Ruiyong Liu, Huinan Du, Marco Calabria
pmc-11591523.description: Implicit causality (IC) is a phenomenon where verbs supply information about the potential cause of the behavior or state to one of the antecedents (e.g., “Mary praised David because…” will continue about David, not Mary). The study examines the influence of IC information and second language (L2) proficiency on Chinese English learners’ pronoun anaphoric inference.

pmc-12429058.title: Chemically induced deceleration of nuclear spin relaxation (CIDER) preserves hyperpolarization
pmc-12429058.creator: Josh P. Peters, Charbel Assaf, Arne Brahms, Kolja Them, Mirco Gerdsen, Rainer Herges, Jan-Bernd Hövener, Andrey N. Pravdivtsev
pmc-12429058.description: Gadolinium-based contrast agents revolutionized magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) by accelerating spin relaxation. In contrast, agents that decelerate relaxation were hitherto unknown. Such agents are highly desirable for metabolic imaging with hyperpolarized tracers such as 15N-pyridine, 1,4-13C2-succinate, and 1-15N-nicotinamide, where valuable polarization decays rapidly, especially at low fields during transfer between polarizer and scanner.

pmc-12569747.title: CCL2/CCR2 signaling pathway in tumorigenesis and metastasis (Review)
pmc-12569747.creator: Ya Zhang, Bin Fan, Hang Yang, Gangxian Chen, Zhou Huang, Ying Li, Xiang Ma, Tiying Wang, Weiquan Wang, Linhao Cai, Lei Han, Yan Liu, Dongqi Li, Xianwei Chen, Yihao Yang, Zuozhang Yang
pmc-12569747.description: C-C motif chemokine ligand 2 (CCL2) is associated with tumorigenesis and cancer progression. C-C motif chemokine receptor 2 (CCR2) is the main receptor of CCL2. The present review aimed to summarize the role of the CCL2/CCR2 signaling axis in tumorigenesis and metastasis.

pmc-12634515.title: Editorial: Women in psychiatry 2024: Psychopharmacology
pmc-12634515.creator: Rosana Camarini, Alfreda Stadlin, Reem K. Jan
pmc-12634515.description: ll led by women scientists, exemplify how rigorous research can advance both mechanistic understanding and practical solutions, while also drawing attention to equity, sex differences, and patient-centered care. These studies remind us that innovation in psychiatry is not only about developing new molecules, but about ensuring that therapeutic advances are relevant and safe for all.

pmc-12688862.title: Unmasking benign intradural-extramedullary spinal tumors: a systematic review on treatment outcomes and radiological features
pmc-12688862.creator: Wojciech Czyżewski, Michał Szymoniuk, Jakub Litak, Jan Sobstyl, Klaudia Kus-Budzynska, Barbara Buchalska, Bipin Chaurasia, Tomasz Mandat, Kamil Torres, Grzegorz Staśkiewicz
pmc-12688862.description: Introduction:Benign intradural extramedullary (IDEM) spinal tumors constitute about 65% of primary spinal neoplasms. Certain primary malignant or metastatic intradural lesions, although infrequent, may resemble their primary counterparts. Moreover, despite significant advances in the operative techniques, morbidity following treatment of IDEM tumors remains a considerable problem.

pmc-13264335.title: Surface morphology modulation in chlorine-doped diisopropylammonium bromide film via Cl-induced domain refinement
pmc-13264335.creator: Jinghan Gao, Xuanyu Liu
pmc-13264335.description: SummaryDiisopropylammonium bromide (DIPAB) has great potential in the field of flexible electronics. However, its room temperature ferroelectricity needs thermal treatment above the irreversible phase-transition temperature (T1), which limits its application. Therefore, chlorine-doped DIPAB (DIPAB-C, C6H16NBr1−xClx) was prepared by spin-coating in this study. XPS confirmed successful Cl incorporation into DIPAB.
